english: Is that the cry of the higurashi...?\nEarly summer in Japan - the season must be June, I wonder.
For now, let's head out to the main road.
Wh-what's wrong, Aria?\nYou're white as a sheet!
I don't know... I feel sick...
I'm worried. Aria-chan, you rest.\nWe'll go gather info around here.
...Sorry.\nI'll do that.
[Fade to black, time passes]
What's wrong with me...?\nIt's not just feeling sick - strange dreams,\nterrifying dreams are burned into my mind...
They happened here in Hinamizawa... huh?\nDid I just say 'Hinamizawa'?\nI shouldn't even know where this place is...?
What's going on? I don't understand...
[Rika appears]
Hello, nanodesu.
You... have I seen you before...?
Won't you take a little walk with me, nanodesu?\nI think I can tell you something\nthat'll cheer Aria up, nanodesu.
Huh... how do you know my name!?
Nipah☆\nLet's go, nanodesu.
[BG: Hinamizawa branch school (day)]
The school... nobody's here.
Today's a day off, nanodesu.\nEveryone's preparing for the festival, nanodesu.
I see...
Aria, don't you\nrecognize this school, nanodesu?
I... feel like I do.
Aria, there are no such things\nas memories that never happened, nanodesu.
If you remember it, Aria,\nthen it really happened, nanodesu.
It really... happened...?
If not here, then in another world...
Aria, please listen carefully\nto what I'm about to tell you.
[Fade to black, time passes]
'Demoning Away.' 'The dam incident.' 'Inside the Saiguden.'\n'Clawing at throats.' 'Sonozaki Mion and Shion.'\n'Satoko's abuse.' The 'Watanagashi' festival.
Aria, do you remember\nwhat I just told you, nanodesu?
...I feel like I do.\nBut this is my first time here,\nyet I remember all of it like I saw it in a dream.
Just as I thought, nanodesu.
Why are you smiling?\nNone of that was anything to smile about.
Right now in Hinamizawa, a change\nthat never happened before is\noccurring, nanodesu. Even Oyashiro-sama is surprised, nanodesu.
Oyashiro-sama - the one behind the curse?
Oyashiro-sama isn't scary, nanodesu.\nThe shrine maiden of Furude Shrine says so,\nso it's true, nanodesu.
Rika was a shrine maiden.\nI've seen plenty of strange things myself,\nbut Oyashiro-sama...
Miii, you can't believe it, nanodesu.\n...True, maybe something is still missing\nto bring about a decisive change, nanodesu.
Honestly, I can't believe\neverything you say either.
Like Rika just said,\nI have memories of witnessing terrible things\nin this Hinamizawa.
Miii...
But that's not all.\nThere are people who saved me,\nand people I wanted to save.
So tell me. What should I do?\nYou know, don't you, Rika?
I don't know that yet, nanodesu.\nMaybe I'll never know...
The three words I hate are\n'impossible,' 'tired,' and 'too much trouble.'\nDon't deny the possibilities - act!
Not... deny the possibilities...?
I don't trust people who can't do that,\nand I won't work with them.
...Understood.\nPlease lend me your strength, nanodesu.
Okay. So what should I do?
There's a place I've thought was suspicious\nfor a while, nanodesu. But it's dangerous,\nand I can't go near it alone, nanodesu.
I want you to go there\nand find out what's there, nanodesu.
If that's all, it's a piece of cake. Leave it to me!
I'll tell everyone and head right over!
[Battle map: plains]
Whoa! The lovelies I recognize\nare crawling all over the place-uu!
Whoa, the creepy ones I've seen before\nare swarming everywhere!
Dream demons too. This presence...\nDoctor Shinigami is definitely lurking here.\nDon't let your guard down!
Aria, nice find.\nAs expected of a Butei, I suppose!
I'm not the one who found it.\nAnyway, there's something here.\nWe're going to expose it!
[Battle starts / Riko appears after a set number of turns or enemies defeated]
Haaah, I'm sooo bored!\nWhy does Riko have to guard\nsuch a boring backwater?
Riko!?
Huh?\nWhy is the whole Ormes gang here?\nYou shouldn't have been able to find this place in a million years?
True, nobody'd come to the backwater\nyou got demoted to for slacking off\nwithout some crazy coincidence.
...I've been bored this whole time.\nLet's make this a big one, Ormes!!
[A horde of grunts appears]
Uwaaah, what a crowd...
In other words, there's something\nthat valuable here!
Now that we know, we can't back down!\n...But these numbers are a bit of a problem.
[Battle resumes / more grunts next turn]
C'mon, c'mon! Do your best, Ormes!
There's more...?
Why are there so many!?
Sorry, but I'm in no position to slack off either.\nI'll overwhelm you with numbers!
[Rena, Mion, Shion, Rika, and Satoko arrive as reinforcements]
O-ho-ho-ho-ho!!\nO-ho-ho-ho-ho-ho!!
How naive!\nYou're so half-baked you'd make a 3 o'clock snack!
Who!?
Aria!!
We came to help!!
You guys!?
Are those the enemies lurking in Hinamizawa\nthat Rika-chama mentioned?
That's right, nanodesu.
You noticed!?\nI didn't sense a thing...!
Of course you must do everything\nwithout being found out.\nIt's written on the first page of the Art of War, you know!
Rika-chan gets the credit, though.
No, it's thanks to everyone, nanodesuu.\nNipah☆
By the way, can you guys fight?
Don't underestimate the club members\nled by Sonozaki Mion, the next head of the Sonozaki family!
We'll show you the fruits of our daily club activities!
The tables have turned, I wonder?\nEveryone, push them back!!
[Battle resumes]
How do you like that!
This match is ours!
Is that so?
That voice!?
[Doctor Shinigami and dream demons, Yase and youkai appear]
You wouldn't say you've forgotten about me, would you?
So you've shown yourself, Doctor Shinigami!
...What, Koto's not here.\nThat's not what I was told!
Just capture them\nand make them spit out her whereabouts.
...Fine!
What are YOU doing here! I didn't hear about this!!
Shut up.
Tch!
What do we do? Fight them head-on like this?
We can't retreat here!
Miii, everyone... to survive,\nwe can't run, nanodesu...!
I know!\nWe can't just leave these guys be!\nTime to dig in, everyone!
I don't wanna lose, kana!
[Battle resumes]
You're reaching your limit, no...?
Limit? I fed that to the fish\nalong with the breadcrumbs!
Even so, at this rate...!
[A mysterious light appears]
Unya?
Honya?
Don't tell me, what they were guarding was...!?
The gears... are turning...?
[Enveloped in light, the allies vanish. / Battle ends]
I-is everyone okay?
I'm fine... but what just happened?
This isn't Hinamizawa, kana? kana?
What about the enemies? Are they not coming after us?
I think we're safe here for now.\nCan't say for sure, though.
I thought I told Rika?\nThat we came from another world.
Yes... but it's still surprising, nanodesu.
Hey, after telling me all that\ncrazy stuff,\nyou didn't believe MY story?
No, that's not it, nanodesu.\nThe fact that *I* would leave Hinamizawa\nis what's so surprising, nanodesu.
Come to think of it, what happened to\nthe Watanagashi festival, I wonder?
With Rika-chan gone,\nthey're probably in a huge uproar right now, kana? kana?
I might get more than just a scolding from Granny... but\nwhat's done is done.
Could you explain the situation?
Uhh, um... you wimp over there!\nI'm leaving it to you!
H-h-huh, me?
[Fade to black, time passes]
Hmm, you've been wandering\nthrough world after world...
It's like a fairy tale, sis.
Well, we've got no choice but to believe it.\nThis isn't Hinamizawa, after all.
Is it okay to be so carefree?
Ahaha, this old man's no good at studyingg.
How do we get back, kana? kana?
That's what we're trying to figure out right now.\nSo I think it'd be good for everyone from Hinamizawa\nto come along with us.
And I want to thank you for the help!
Hauu, Rika-chan\nlooks really happy somehow.\nDid something good happen, kana? kana?
Yes, nanodesu.
(Though it's not all good)
So, what kind of bad guys\nwere the ones we just fought?
Were they hiding in Hinamizawa,\nplotting something evil?
Looks like they're definitely\nenemies of our club!
We also need to solve the mystery\nof how this happened.
Mion-san,\nI propose we bolster the club's membership!
Adopted! So,\nI'd like to add everyone here as new members\nof the club - what do you say?
...Huh?
Aye!
Club???
Uwaah! It's like school-uu!
Nice! Nicee! Sounds like fun!
Shii joins too, nanodesuu.
Me too?
Club, huh... sounds kind of nostalgic!
(Just how old ARE you...)
(I feel it... something Hinamizawa never had -\na power that pushes forward...\nSomething that creates change... this is fine for now)
Hey, Rika... was this okay?
Hm?
Nipah☆
[Fade to black / BG: Hinamizawa (night)]
Rem... I thought luring her to Hinamizawa\nwould bring about change. Then what to do...
It seems I need to change my methods a bit.
